According to the constraints [constr_3485] and [constr_3486] a
Proxy
and
Skeleton
cannot be bound to the identical local endpoint (IP address and port). Hence, a local
endpoint can either act as a TLS client or as a TLS server exclusively. However, if mul-
tiple
Proxys
are bound to the same endpoint, their common channel shall be shared
in the middleware. Likewise, if multiple
Skeletons
are bound to the same endpoint,
their common channel shall be shared in the middleware.
